notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
description:
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {2}{W}, causing yourself to gain five life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
